notes.notes: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p]Our latest game Mai: Child of Ages has just been released, check out the game page![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Venture through past and future, exploring Zelda-like dungeons, and uncover the bond that ties Mai to the enigmatic figure who will guide her throughout the adventure, teaching her the mastery of the arcane Uroboro Stone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29702066/72b53e05a8f0fba9bcdf978c219956ba25e42715.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Also new updates for Suicide Guy 2 are coming, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Updates and new game!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello my friends![/p][p]A new update is coming for the game with [b]improved graphics and Bug fixes[/b] soon next month and also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in an enhanced edition![/p][p]
[/p][p]Meanwhile if you want to check out our [b]new upcoming adventure game[/b][/p][p]check it out and add to wishlist here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In this game you'll follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set sail with Mai and travel through time, journeying across both past and future, thanks to a Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Observe how the world transforms before your eyes and adapt your actions accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3499550/extras/Gif4.4_2.gif?t=1752767160"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay & A Deep Storyline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as Mai in the different stages of her life, harnessing the unique abilities in childhood and adolescence to face the challenges ahead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience a natural progression of gameplay mechanics, from precision platforming to hack and slash combat, while unlocking new abilities for Mai through Metroidvania-style progression, expanding her exploration and combat possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate, abandoned factories to discover and submerged worlds to explore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gather hidden clues with Mai to unravel the past, uncovering the events that led to humanity’s extinction, and discover what fate awaits the world after their disappearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The game is coming in September, stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Mai: Child of Ages - Announcement Trailer
notes.notes: [p]Hello my friends!  [/p][p]Today, we unveiled the launch trailer for [b]Mai: Child of Ages[/b], our upcoming action-adventure game coming to Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5, Xbox and Steam this September!  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u9wPekgjNhY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can add to [b]wishlist[/b] here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p] [b]✨ A timeless odyssey[/b]  [/p][p]Join Mai on her journey through a fractured world as she uncovers her true identity and confronts mysterious beings threatening the balance of the universe. [/p][p][/p][p]Venture through past and future, exploring ancient dungeons, and uncover the bond that ties Mai to the enigmatic figure who will guide her throughout the adventure, teaching her the mastery of the arcane Uroboro Stone.   [/p][p][/p][p]The game blends precision platforming, dynamic hack-and-slash combat, and metroidvania-style progression in a rich, time-bending adventure.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703768/172b32062c2386cf0466b4d2e0eb2c3cffe8fc0f.png"][/img]The development of the game began in 2020. [/p][p][/p][p]Our vision was to create a unique gameplay experience, with Time as the core mechanic and a story that deeply immerses the players in the game world. [/p][p]In the beginning, the complexity and scale of the project felt overwhelming, especially for a small team of just five developers. [/p][p][/p][p]But we were driven by the desire to explore new ideas and craft something truly original.  Building a believable world where the protagonist, Mai, could move between past and present, shaping both realities, was our greatest challenge. [/p][p][/p][p]Yet we’re confident that the mechanics have evolved into something truly captivating.    [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703768/f4a4161f8611e6bebe4318fc9a21a3c430138531.png"][/img][/p][p]In the latest trailer, you’ll catch a glimpse of vast environments, time-warping puzzles, and the emotional journey that awaits Mai across the ages.   [/p][p][/p][p]The story revolves around the connections between past, present, and future, and how each can influence the others.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the main protagonist, players will also take control of a second character, unveiling new layers of the narrative from an alternate perspective. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703768/ede303f2f5207c66f5cf492426a520870bb1c6c1.png"][/img][/p][p]The protagonist, Mai, will be guided on her journey by an ancient, long-forgotten civilization—a reminder of how vital the past can be, even when it is often overlooked.  [/p][p][/p][p]The main story offers around 20 hours of gameplay, but due to the complexity of puzzles and challenges, the actual playtime will depend on each player’s skills. If things get tough, players can team up with friends thanks to the Coop Mode, already included in the main game.  [/p][p][/p][p]Add to your wishlist and follow the game:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] Follow us on X: [/p][p][url="https://x.com/ChubbyPixel"]https://x.com/ChubbyPixel[/url][/p][p][/p][p] Follow us on TikTok:  [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@chubbypixelgames"]https://www.tiktok.com/@chubbypixelgames[/url][/p][p][/p][p] subscribe to Youtube:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@MalboM"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]And join our Discord Server for updates:  [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel"]https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait to share more with you! [/p][p][b]Chubby Pixel Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703768/71d2f86d0e3e96ccc56c932611398b05c7544fcd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Suicide Guy VR Deluxe available today for PlayStation VR2!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
The latest VR edition of Suicide Guy is today available for PlayStation VR2!

Check it out!

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008626


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29702066/a1be279db82ef737556b4922c9074402d6bfbf84.jpg[/img]


A first person puzzle game like no other where you'll have to find the way out of your own dreams using objects and tools that you'll obtain during the nap.

Play this super immersive experience with your PSVR2 Device.


[b]Features:[/b]

- New awesome levels that take full advantage of VR devices

- Full body locomotion in Virtual Reality

- Total physics control of all items

- New incredible moves: be able to pick up items, throw them, activate mechanisms and even burp.

- Driving System redesigned for VR

- Teleport movement style extra option (if your stomach can't take it)

- An important mission to accomplish (again)


[b]What Does the new Deluxe edition includes?[/b]

- Graphics and performance improvements

- Fully adapted for PlayStation VR2 devices

- Improved comfort for VR

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 of the best new Steam games
notes.notes:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round up of ten of the best (or thereabouts) new games released on Steam that have not, as yet, enjoyed the fifteen minutes of fame that they deserve.

This week: I’m actually covering two weeks’ worth of games rather than the usual seven-day crop, as I was away for a bunch of last week. The larger pool means more strong options than usual, including: high-speed 4X, FMV anxiety attacks, minimalist Shadow of the Colossus and the singular nightmare that is Hand Simulator. (more…)
